connector.name: Unmarkdown
connector.registryDescription: The document publishing layer for AI tools. Convert markdown to 6 destinations, 62 templates.
connector.summary: Hosted at unmarkdown.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the unmarkdown account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNMARKDOWN_API_KEY
env.description: Your Unmarkdown API key (starts with um_). Get one from Settings > API in your Unmarkdown account.
